blocked_reason: No automation channel can reach the status-bar popover that hosts the prompt field: the process is not frontmost, its AX menu bar reports a position off the single 1920x1080 display, CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo returns no windows (no Screen Recording permission) and screencapture cannot read the display. The installed app itself launched, stayed alive and wrote only to the isolated roots.
minimum_unblock: Grant Screen Recording + Accessibility to the driving terminal, then run the same sequence: AXPress the status-bar item, type into the popover's prompt field, read the streamed answer and the native_mlx_trace.log for the real generation.
Or run this leg on a host with an attended GUI session and capture the same evidence files (window list, screenshot, trace log, model output).
